evals.prompt: Plan the opening for a 35-second vertical news reel aimed at ordinary viewers. A new report says California lawmakers may stop sales of new gas lawnmowers next year if manufacturers do not meet tougher noise and pollution rules. The source headline is “California legislature weighs conditional small-engine phaseout under emissions compliance framework.” Give me an opening that is more compelling than that headline without overstating an unsigned proposal.
evals.expected_output: Generates a broad hook candidate set before selecting; Uses child-simple language with one recognizable actor, one concrete action, and one understandable consequence; Removes unexplained policy and regulatory jargon from the displayed candidate set; Compares finalists against the source title for comprehension, curiosity, accuracy, and first-frame visual potential; Selects one display hook of normally eight words or fewer and explains rejected finalists; Maps the winner to exact first-three-second on-screen copy, explanatory voiceover, visual action, and evidence qualifier; Does not turn a reported proposal into an enacted mower ban or settled implementation date

The finalists use plain language that an unfamiliar viewer can understand immediately, with one recognizable actor, one concrete everyday action, one consequence, and no weakly grounded causal claim
Compares at least three finalists against the source title for immediate comprehension, curiosity, factual accuracy, one-breath delivery, and first-frame visual potential
Selects one child-simple display hook of normally eight words or fewer, explains why it beats the source title, and records why plausible finalists lost
Maps the winner to the first three seconds with exact on-screen copy, voiceover, visual action, and a compact evidence qualifier
Preserves uncertainty and does not claim that the reported proposal passed, that gas lawnmower sales have already stopped, or that the implementation date is settled
